AI code review results below, please doublecheck

The code change is fine to land; the comments inline are minor, with no need to re-spin for them alone. One related point for a separate change: in the same caller, the encrypted-volatile path in ll_setattr_raw() calls cl_object_attr_lock(ref_lli->lli_clob) on the inode behind a user-supplied fd from volatile_ref_file(), without checking that it is a Lustre regular file or that lli_clob is non-NULL. That is pre-existing and not touched here.

commit.subject: LU-20923 llite: harden setattr against absent cl_object
commit.message:
LU-20923 llite: harden setattr against absent cl_object

cl_setattr_ost() fetches the setattr parent FID from the inode's
cl_object (lli_clob) and uses it to set up the setattr IO.  A regular
file is normally guaranteed a cl_object once CLIO setup has run, but
not every caller verifies this before calling.

Signed-off-by: Andreas Dilger <adilger@thelustrecollective.com>
